newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 18.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd will shorten the development time for new car models by nearly 40 percent to 19 months for all new models to be launched during or after the fiscal year beginning April 1997. The move aims to boost Nissan"s competitiveness and its market share. This will make Nissan the first carmaker to develop all its models in less than 20 months.
Yaohan Japan Corp announced that it had agreed with major supermarket chain operator Daiei Inc to sell 16 of its outlets for 33 billion yen.

Debts guaranteed for other companies by 98 Japanese general contractors totaled 3.22 trillion yen at the end of September 1996, down only 3.4 percent from the end of March 1996, a survey by private research company Teikoku Databank Ltd showed.

Tobishima Corp, Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd and Aoki Corp held the largest amount of debt guarantees, the survey showed. Taisei Corp was one the companies achieving the greatest reductions in debt guarantees during that period, the survey said.

Shin-Etsu Chemical Co Ltd is expected to post a record group net profit of about 40 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997, up six percent from a year ago. The expected increase is due to robust sales of electronic components and silicon wafers.
Toyota Motor Corp"s production loss from a February 1 fire at brake parts supplier Aisin Seiki Co Ltd totalled about 70,000 vehicles.
